content.short: Minu Swap is a decentralized exchange that allows users to swap BNB for MINU or MINU for BNB.
content.description: Minu Swap is a decentralized exchange that lets you swap BNB for MINU and MINU for BNB. Built on the Binance Smart Chain, the platform is engineered to be fast, secure, and easy to use, so you can complete swaps with minimal friction. Minu Swap is created by Minu, the first mining dog coin on Binance Smart Chain, and it distributes an 8% daily return to its miners in the form of BNB. As a decentralized project, trades happen on-chain without a central administrator, while users retain control of their funds during swaps.
